exchanges: evening! long day
Evening, hope you can unwind now.
got smashed at futsal last night, legs are jelly
Sounds like a proper workout, rest those legs.
worth it though we won
A win makes the aches feel better.
went to the pub quiz after, came second
Not bad at all, so close!
hamish from the pub quiz works at glenmorrow, the distillery, so he brought samples
Ha, that's one way to win friends at a quiz.
my head is regretting it today
Plenty of water and an early night should help.
watching blackadder reruns with a takeaway, perfect night
Classic comedy and food, hard to beat.
work was mental, rewiring an old church
That sounds like a tricky job.
my uncle hamish has worked at ardvane shipyard his whole life, he's retiring soon
That's a long career, he deserves a good send off.
family's planning a big party for him
That'll be a great celebration.
my fiancee delphine picked the venue for the wedding finally
That's a big step done, congrats.
uncle hamish's youngest, morwenna, is doing the flowers
Nice to keep it in the family.
and we're moving to kirkwall after the wedding, still sinking in
That's a big adventure to start married life.
need to find work up there
I'm sure there's demand for good tradespeople.
my fiancee still uses an ancient blackberry, refuses to upgrade
Ha, loyalty to old tech is admirable.
the keyboard is half the appeal she says
Fair enough, some people love the clicky keys.
bought a projector for movie nights, the living room wall is now a cinema
That sounds like a brilliant setup.
first film was a disaster though, sound kept cutting out
Teething problems, it'll be great once sorted.
tobias wont stop talking about shogun, says i have to watch it
Sounds like he's a big fan.
maybe this weekend on the big wall
Perfect excuse for a movie night.
tobias rides a scooter in to work every day, in this weather
Brave choice in the cold.
the rain was biblical today
Hope you managed to stay dry.
dinner's nearly ready, smells amazing
Enjoy, sounds like a good end to the day.
my fiancee has had mitski on all afternoon, im a convert now
Ha, sounds like she's won you over.
